paragraphs.source_en: “Vulcan was a blacksmith, and this blacksmith’s son stole the cattle. Only, he led them off backward, tugging them by their tails. When Hercules woke up, he went searching everywhere for the cattle, but he could not find them. Of course he could not find them, because the thief had dragged the cattle backward by the tails, so all the hoofprints pointed forward. For a blacksmith’s son, it was quite an idea.” Mr. Meitei had already forgotten the original subject of the weather, and was growing more animated as he talked.
